description: OTH Knowledge read-only consumption boundary (docs/OTH_KNOWLEDGE_INTEGRATION.md). Ships disabled: no persistent private knowledge store exists on this host yet — provisioning it is an owner/operator decision recorded in the handover blockers. To activate, set enabled=true and store_root to an absolute path OUTSIDE this repository; the knowledge store must never live in Git. The executor can only ever READ knowledge through this wiring — ingestion and curation stay on the operator CLI paths.
